parts:
Here’s a clean, simple summary you can send to Jacques:

---

Hey, I just had a really interesting call with a guy named Jesse and I want to loop you in because this could be big on the B2B side for us.

He’s built a system that basically replaces all the broken LinkedIn outreach tools. Instead of using platforms like HeyReach or Prosp (which we already know don’t work consistently), he uses dedicated phones that act like real humans doing outreach 24/7. So it’s not a bot in the traditional sense. It actually logs into LinkedIn, connects, messages, follows up, and even engages with content in a way that avoids detection and keeps accounts safe.

What stood out is:
- It does true 1:1 personalized outreach at scale  
- It runs continuously without needing a VA or manual effort  
- It can integrate with our current systems (GHL, Instantly, Apollo lists, etc.)  
- It works especially well when paired with existing funnels, ads, and leads  

Where this gets really interesting for us is B2B.

This would allow us to:
- Consistently connect with med spa owners, PE firms, skincare brands, device companies, etc.  
- Layer LinkedIn outreach on top of our cold email + ads  
- Re-engage leads who hit our funnel but don’t book  
- Build real partnerships and deal flow, not just leads  

It basically fills the gap we’ve been talking about. We can post content all day, but this actually creates conversations.

He’s still early with it and looking to test with a few people, but it’s already working on his end and it’s honestly the first LinkedIn solution I’ve seen that makes sense.

I think this is 100% something you need to see because it’s more in your world than mine, especially with how it could plug into everything you’ve been building on the backend.

Do you want to jump on a call with him next week and just explore how this could fit into our system?

---

If you want, I can tighten this into a Slack version or make it more technical for Jacques.

Perfect, here’s a tighter, more “Jacques-style” version you can drop in Slack:

---

Hey, I just got off a call with a guy named Jesse and I want you on a call with him next week. This is very much in your lane.

He built a LinkedIn outreach system that replaces tools like Prosp / HeyReach. Instead of browser-based automation (which keeps breaking), it runs through dedicated phones acting like real users. So it’s not a typical bot. It handles connection requests, personalized messaging, follow-ups, and light engagement continuously without triggering platform issues.

Key points:
- True 1:1 personalized outreach at scale (not templated spam)
- Runs 24/7 without VAs or manual intervention
- Can plug into Apollo + Instantly + GHL
- Can also loop back and re-engage leads from our funnels who didn’t convert

Why I think this matters for us:
This solves our B2B gap.

We could use it to:
- Consistently connect with med spa owners (our ICP)
- Build partnerships with skincare, devices, peptides, etc.
- Layer on top of email + ads for multi-touch outreach
- Recycle warm leads who didn’t book into LinkedIn conversations

It’s basically the missing piece between traffic and actual conversations.

He’s early and testing it with a few people, but it’s already working on his side. From what I can tell, this isn’t something we currently have or anything you’ve built yet.

Would you be open to jumping on a call with him next week to break it down and see how it could integrate with what you’re building?

---

If you want, I can also add a more technical section depending on how deep you want to go with him.
